recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Dependency. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Montserrat. Parliamentary democracy; self-governing overseas territory of the uk.
capital: Plymouth · Plymouth was abandoned in 1997 because of volcanic activity; interim government buildings have been built at Brades Estate, the de facto capital, at the northwest end of Montserrat
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor Sarah TUCKER (since 6 April 2023); Premier Easton TAYLOR-FARRELL (since 19 November 2019)
government: parliamentary democracy; self-governing overseas territory of the UK
economy: formerly high-income economy; volcanic activity destroyed much of original infrastructure and economy; new capital and port is being developed; key geothermal and solar power generation; key music recording operations GDP (PPP): $89.254 million (2024 est.). note: data in 2015 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Royal Montserrat Defense Force (ceremonial, civil defense duties), Montserrat Police Force (2025)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
